text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Ingress API gateway (api-gw-prod) is reporting a sustained spike in 502/504s across the edge tier starting ~01:02 UTC. Error rate 5xx = 18% over last 5m. Pager routed to ben_oncall.

emily_support: Customers reporting errors for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Notes: multiple timeouts seen from EU customers, support queue rising.

ben_oncall: I'm on it, joining dashboards now. pulling up ingress and proxy logs.

dmitri_sre: Looking at proxy metrics — connection pool saturating on edge-proxy pods in eu-west-1, many upstream read timeouts. I see a correlation with a traffic-weighting change pushed ~01:05 UTC to shift traffic to new mux.

carla_se: FYI I rolled a route weight experiment earlier for model routing (traffic-split v2) at 01:05, small percentage initially but looks like it bumped concurrency on a set of older proxy nodes.

ben_oncall: Confirming logs:
```
2026-03-17T01:07:12Z proxy[edge-3] ERROR upstream read timeout id=abcd1234 path=/v1/generate host=api.redwood.com
2026-03-17T01:07:12Z proxy[edge-3] WARN connection_pool exhausted (max=200)
```

dmitri_sre: Suggested immediate mitigations: 1) scale edge-proxy replicas 2) enforce per-route circuit-breaker backoff to fail fast for unhealthy upstreams 3) shift some traffic to fallback-gateway cluster.

ben_oncall: Scaling now -> `kubectl -n apigw scale deploy edge-proxy --replicas=6`

ben_oncall: Applying temporary circuit-breaker/backoff for /v1 route (30s window):
```
redwoodctl gateway apply --name api-gw-prod --patch 'routes:/v1:backoff={initial:100ms, max:5s},circuit_breaker={5xx_threshold:10,window:30s,reset:60s}'
```

incident-bot: Pager update: ben_oncall accepted.

carla_se: Reverting the routing weight experiment to 0% now: `redwoodctl route set-weight traffic-split-v2 0` — starting rollback.

ben_oncall: Shifting 40% traffic to fallback-gateway-2 (us-west standby) via quick reroute.

emily_support: Customer impact summary (rolling 5m): ~12% of requests return 502/504, affected orgs: Acme Corp, Nova Labs, two smaller customers. No data deletion, just request failures. Escalating to account reps.

ben_oncall: After scale + circuit-breaker + rollback, 5xx trend decreasing to ~4% over last 2m. Seeing fewer connection_pool exhausted logs.

dmitri_sre: Good sign. I'll keep watch on connection pool metrics and edge-proxy heap/FDs. Plan: revert experiment permanently if stable, follow up with a safer rollout and throttling.

carla_se: Opening a post-incident ticket with rollout metadata and checks. Will include the experiment config and offsets.

ben_oncall: Handing to monitoring watch team for 30m observation window. If errors resurge, page again.

emily_support: Notifying affected customers and providing ETA for resolution (30m watch).

ben_oncall: Final: 502s down to ~2.3% now, latency normalized. Leaving a short runbook entry in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:

dmitri_sre: Follow-ups: add stricter circuit-breaker defaults for route experiments, add pre-rollout load-check to traffic-split pipeline. Reference playbook: <https://console.redwood/ops/playbooks/ingress-502-backoff>

emily_support: Thanks — continuing to monitor support queue and update customers.

ben_oncall: Closing live triage now, watch team will keep an eye. If anything pops, reopen pager.
